about: Starter list written 15 Sep 2026 from what Dubai buyers, tenants, investors and developers routinely ask, checked against the app's screens and data that day. Naj's notes add what it missed. No personal data belongs in this file.

statuses.answered: the app answers it today; where names the screen and link
statuses.held: we hold the data but no screen shows it; source names it
statuses.needs_data: new data would be needed; source names the likely one
statuses.by_rule: not answered, by rule; note names the rule

links: both links = the client link and Naj's private link; private link = only with the residents key

questions.note: Publishable since Kendall's decision of 17 Sep 2026 (methodology section 11, Framing), replacing the 14 Sep internal-only rule. Held rather than answered because the only screen showing it is the RESIDENTS page, still behind the residents key, so nothing a client opens shows it yet. Community grain only, never per building; groups at 5% or more, whole percents. Never tied to a home or listing, and never a filter for choosing where to live.
